import numpy as np
def _cloud(seed, n=6, spread=0.02):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    X = rng.uniform(0.0, spread, size=(n, 2))
    u = rng.normal(size=(n, 2)) * spread * 0.02
    return X, X + u
def _hor(seed, n=6, lo=0.008, hi=0.016):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 500)
    return rng.uniform(lo, hi, size=n)
def _vol(seed, n=6):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed + 900)
    return rng.uniform(0.5e-6, 2.0e-6, size=n)
